visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a bright, white studio set decorated with cute animal dolls and wall stickers. A host wearing a grey hoodie sits on the left, holding a purple tablet and gesturing animatedly with his mouth wide open. To his right, guest Jasper Liu wears large black headphones and a white patterned shirt, looking confused and leaning forward to read the host's lips. (2) A sharp cut occurs to a wide shot of a music video featuring the K-pop group Girls' Generation. Nine women in brightly colored yellow and pink shorts perform a synchronized dance routine in a minimalist white circular room with flat studio lighting. (3) The scene returns to the studio where the host is now leaning even closer to the guest, exaggeratedly articulating syllables while pointing at the tablet. Jasper Liu mimics the host's mouth movements with a furrowed brow, attempting to guess the words. (4) The host throws his head back in laughter, nearly falling off his stool, as a green checkmark graphic appears on the screen to indicate a correct guess. Jasper Liu removes his headphones, smiling and laughing in relief at the conclusion of the game.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male host speaking Mandarin with bright, sharp intonation, introducing the game. An upbeat, major-key electronic pop track with a steady 4/4 beat plays in the background at a moderate volume. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX triggers a cut to a snippet of Girls' Generation's 'Gee,' featuring synchronized female pop vocals and a high-tempo synth-driven melody. (3) The audio shifts back to the host, who is shouting syllables with high vocal arousal and exaggerated clarity to help the guest guess. The BGM remains energetic. (4) Frequent 'bubble pop' and 'cartoon ding' sound effects highlight the guest's attempts and successes. (5) The recording ends with explosive laughter from both speakers, a rising synth stinger, and the host shouting 'Correct!' with high dominance and valence.
